name: pytorch-rocm-halo
description: Pinned PyTorch/ROCm multi-arch base for AMD Strix Halo / RDNA3.5 / gfx1151. Installs the complete ROCm 7.15.0a20260719 core, development, common library, and gfx1151 device wheel set plus matching PyTorch host, gfx1151 device-code, and torchvision wheels, then exports ABI constraints for downstream vLLM builds.
